currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated south side: west twin staged towers with green domes/lanterns; long dark high nave and lower aisle roofs; oval clerestory windows; three large rounded eastern/transept arms with green half-conical roofs; tall central octagonal drum/green dome/lantern. Pale weathered body stone contrasts with whiter tower/front trim. Arcades, adjacent wings,plazas and sculpture columns remain separate.

Inspected full front: two tall staged towers with strong projecting cornices, paired pilasters, lower clocks and open tall belfry arches, octagonal upper stage/green domes/open lanterns/crosses. Three tall recessed round entrance arches, upper window rows and pediments, curved shoulders to central triangular gable, selected roofline/base statues. Exact carved reliefs, inscriptions,sculpture and interior portal rooms omitted.
